dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp, thin pale boundaries bordering the dark centers of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A diffuse and non-linear transition boundary where the lighter grey plumage of the crown gradually darkens into the scaled mantle texture.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and highly regular scalloped patterning across the entire dorsal surface caused by light grey or white feather margins.
